speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions. To begin our evaluation, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and did the skin lesions appear before or after the pain started?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Septic Arthritis (Left Wrist) secondary to Lyme disease or Gonococcal arthritis.

I have already noted the camping history in Minnesota and recent sexual activity from your report; to confirm the diagnosis, I need to request blood work and imaging. REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, CRP, Blood_Culture, Gonorrhea_Nucleic_Acid_Amplification_Test, Lyme_Serology. REQUEST IMAGES: Left_Wrist_XRay, Left_Wrist_Ultrasound.
